Synthetic payment records for tests/payments.test.ts. Instruction, provider and bank rows are
made up; every transaction hash is a real public transfer recorded in tests/fixtures/live/ (or,
for 4a1d0f…, a hash recorded as not found on any chain). bvnk-report-*.csv use the BVNK
reference mapping's column names; acme-report.csv is a different, invented provider format.
No real customer data.
